units.english: The Petrel is a multi-role mining/wing leader fightercraft designed to provide support for flights of lighter Terns in high-risk environments. The ship's design originated as an urban mobile gun platform that flitted around structures and natural terrain, but proved easy to adapt into a spacecraft.
units.raw: description "The Petrel is a multi-role mining/wing leader fightercraft designed to provide support for flights of lighter Terns in high-risk environments. The ship's design originated as an urban mobile gun platform that flitted around structures and natural terrain, but proved easy to adapt into a spacecraft."

units.english: The Remnant are loath to sacrifice pilots and crew from the comparatively small pool they are drawn from. As such, their fighters are equipped with medium-range weaponry designed to strike enemies from afar.
units.raw: description "	The Remnant are loath to sacrifice pilots and crew from the comparatively small pool they are drawn from. As such, their fighters are equipped with medium-range weaponry designed to strike enemies from afar."

units.english: Fighters do not come equipped with a hyperdrive. You cannot carry a fighter unless you have a ship in your fleet with a fighter bay.
units.raw: description "	Fighters do not come equipped with a hyperdrive. You cannot carry a fighter unless you have a ship in your fleet with a fighter bay."

units.english: Centuries ago, the Remnant built these ships in order to explore the upper atmosphere of nearby gas giants. The Archons took issue with the Remnant's research methods, and the studies were unable to be completed. The remaining Puffins have been gathering dust in storage for centuries while the Remnant wait to see if the anger of the Archons will subside.
units.raw: description "Centuries ago, the Remnant built these ships in order to explore the upper atmosphere of nearby gas giants. The Archons took issue with the Remnant's research methods, and the studies were unable to be completed. The remaining Puffins have been gathering dust in storage for centuries while the Remnant wait to see if the anger of the Archons will subside."

units.english: The Remnant have long favored turns of action that avoid putting crew directly at risk; though their Terns are a rather effective result of this ideology, the Remnant still had to face the fact that, eventually, one of their manned ships was going to end up too crippled to escape to safety. To that end, the Smew was developed; though quite lightly armed, Smews are capable of carrying a considerable quantity of cargo and passengers for a ship of their size, and are durable enough to absorb some fire from enemies while doing so.

To that end, the Smew was developed; though quite lightly armed, Smews are capable of carrying a considerable quantity of cargo and passengers for a ship of their size, and are durable enough to absorb some fire from enemies while doing so."

units.english: Though originally designed as lifeboats, the surprisingly mobile freighter-fighter hybrid has seen a remarkable amount of usage in mining fleets, as a way to supplement the otherwise poor cargo capacity of the Ibis. Because their purpose can vary from fleet to fleet, Smews are traditionally sold with a fair amount of free space: enough for a small weapon, upgraded engines, or additional support systems.

units.english: One of the strangest and most useful things that the Remnant have discovered in the abandoned worlds of the Ember Waste is alien cloaking technology. They have designed their scout ships to cloak when needed in order to explore alien territory without being seen... or to escape in a hurry after stealing something particularly valuable from those aliens.
units.raw: description "One of the strangest and most useful things that the Remnant have discovered in the abandoned worlds of the Ember Waste is alien cloaking technology. They have designed their scout ships to cloak when needed in order to explore alien territory without being seen... or to escape in a hurry after stealing something particularly valuable from those aliens."

units.english: The cloaking technology is built into the Starling's hull; it cannot be removed or transferred to another ship.
units.raw: description "	The cloaking technology is built into the Starling's hull; it cannot be removed or transferred to another ship."

units.english: With the advent of more powerful ramscoops, the need for extensive propellant logistics networks all but disappeared. The Swan had the misfortune of being born as a tanker; as such, it had to survive as nothing more than a set of detailed drawings inside some dusty folders. Eventually, decades after its conception, the need for such a vehicle became apparent and production could finally begin.
units.raw: description "With the advent of more powerful ramscoops, the need for extensive propellant logistics networks all but disappeared. The Swan had the misfortune of being born as a tanker; as such, it had to survive as nothing more than a set of detailed drawings inside some dusty folders. Eventually, decades after its conception, the need for such a vehicle became apparent and production could finally begin."

units.english: On top of its fuel-storage capabilities, the Swan makes for an interesting warship in its own right. Four drone bays have been added below its fuel-bearing wings, each a fair bit larger than the Terns they tend to carry. On top of this, despite not being nearly as well-shielded, its weapons complement nears that of the Albatross: in essence, it is the largest support ship the Remnant have built.

units.english: The Tern is a small, hardy drone developed to plunge into the atmosphere of nearby gas giants for collecting valuable resources. These thick-shelled craft are also surprisingly effective when pressed into service as screening ships when enemies intrude into Remnant space.
units.raw: description "The Tern is a small, hardy drone developed to plunge into the atmosphere of nearby gas giants for collecting valuable resources. These thick-shelled craft are also surprisingly effective when pressed into service as screening ships when enemies intrude into Remnant space."

units.english: Unlike most spacefaring nations, the Remnant do not have enough people to pilot fighter wings in waves likely to sustain significant casualties. As such, they frequently use these hardy drones to fulfill similar screening roles in their home systems, allowing manned craft to focus on more specialized tasks.
